name: AWEFonts static font providers

providers.name: Google Fonts
providers.license: Per-family; commonly OFL-1.1, Apache-2.0 or UFL-1.0

providers.name: Fontsource
providers.coverage: Open-source font packages beyond Google Fonts

runtime: Static client-side discovery only. AWEFonts does not proxy, cache, or modify provider responses.
privacy: Search and previews run in the browser. Provider catalog requests go directly from the visitor's browser to the named public providers.
